title: Workcell Hazard Spotter
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Robot Safety
description: Look at eight numbered items in a schematic desk scene with a robot arm and classify each one as a pinch point, a collision hazard, an electrical hazard or acceptable. Used in Chapter 3.

educational.topic: Spotting pinch-point, collision and electrical hazards around a desk robot arm
learningObjectives: Distinguish pinch-point, collision and electrical hazards from acceptable items in a desk robot-arm scene, in eight items, with at least 7 of 8 correct on the first attempt

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Read the items in an explore mode first, then classify each one by its mechanism of harm (trapping, striking, shocking or none) with one attempt each
keyQuestions: What could trap a finger or a sleeve here?
What could the arm strike as it moves?
Which items near the arm are good practice and not hazards?
commonMisconceptions: Anything near the arm is a hazard
Water near a power supply is only a spill risk
assessmentOpportunities: Eight committed classes, one attempt each; 7 of 8 for mastery

controls.label: Explore mode: hover over or click a numbered ring to read the item name
Four class buttons: Pinch point, Collision, Electrical, Acceptable
Next item / See score / Try again
